label: PF Backlog 609
title: Hard DoD gate: every item needs detailed Acceptance Criteria + independent verification (verifier != implementer) before close/merge

brief.what_adds: Hard gates requiring detailed AC + independent (verifier != implementer) verification before close/merge
brief.problem: Items can be closed/merged with weak or absent AC and self-verified, so partial work passes

objective: Hard DoD gate: every item needs detailed Acceptance Criteria + independent verification (verifier != implementer) before close/merge
acceptance_criteria: WRITE-TIME (hard): POST /backlog/items REJECTS a non-epic create with no acceptance_criteria or any criterion < 40 chars (HTTP 400, error VALIDATION_FAILED); verified by test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_backlog_dod.py
PRECHECK FAST (hard): scripts/dev/backlog_dod_check.py runs in precheck fast tier and FAILS for any non-epic open item without detailed AC (baseline-aware: config/backlog-dod-baseline.json)
INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION (hard): the gate FAILS when a DELIVERED item lacks non-empty verification/evidence (baseline-aware)
WIRING: registered in config/ci-cd-gates.json + scripts/dev/precheck.py (fast) + config/store-registry.json
EVIDENCE: no-AC create returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED and the gate returns exit 1 on a non-compliant item; compliant items PASS
in_scope: Hard DoD gate: every item needs detailed Acceptance Criteria + independent verification (verifier != implementer) before close/merge
approach: Hard DoD gate: every item needs detailed Acceptance Criteria + independent verification (verifier != implementer) before close/merge
verification: precheck fast PASS 40 gates; test_backlog_dod.py 3 passed (no-AC/short-AC -> 400 VALIDATION_FAILED); gate prints OK

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/verification_policy.py and core/verification_runner.py to require structured Acceptance Criteria on every item before it can enter execution; extend core/merge_gate.py to hard-block close/merge unless a verifier (actor != implementer) recorded a passing verification against those criteria; expose status via /api/v1/backlog/items/{item_id} and /api/v1/audit/acceptance.

dependency_findings.required_state: security gate runs alongside new DoD gate

conflict_findings: core/merge_gate.py also touched by BI-0205 - sequence or coordinate changes
Backlog item schema changes may collide with BI-0179 per-file storage refactor
duplication_findings: core/verification_runner.py already runs independent verifications - reuse, do not rebuild
core/compliance_verifier.py covers guideline compliance - different axis, keep separate
core/merge_gate.py already gates merges - extend with AC-verification check only
BI-PF-1221 security gate is additive, not duplicative
analysis.rationale: Existing verification and gate infrastructure makes this a policy-plus-gate extension rather than a new subsystem; the main unknowns are rollout scope and independence definition.
assumptions: Actor identity (implementer vs verifier) is already captured by the run system
Verification runner supports per-item, per-criteria pass/fail results
Existing closed items are grandfathered or backfilled, not auto-rejected
risks: Enforcement retroactive on existing items may mass-block the pipeline
Verifier identity tracking needs reliable actor attribution in runs
False sense of rigor if ACs are trivially written to pass
evidence: Candidate components include verification_policy, verification_runner, merge_gate
config/verification-policy.json already exists for policy-driven thresholds
missing_info: Retroactive policy: apply only to newly opened items or backfill all?
Minimum AC quality bar (who authors ACs, template/required sections)?
What counts as independent: human-only, agent-vs-agent, or same?

context_review.reason: Every field is the same boilerplate sentence; no concrete mechanism, repo/tool (e.g. CI workflow, PR template, hook), affected files, or enforcement design is specified.
